title: A Happy Celebration
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler whose warmth spills over into sharing, and tonight Esther’s people turn their rescue into a feast with gifts for one another and for the poor: Willow has two cookies, sees a friend with none, and shares.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because she loves to share joy and give to others. In Willow’s world today: Willow had two cookies and saw a friend who had none. She thought about keeping both… but instead she said, “Here — let’s share!” Both girls giggled with happy, full hearts. Just like the people shared gifts at their celebration, Willow learned that joy grows bigger the moment we share it.
